resolution.reason: Frozen spec now names 8192-character limits for completion.reason, finding.description, source_disposition and source_verification, with C2 overflow rejection.

findings.title: Free-text reason and source claims lack named length limits

summary: The three findings in the first design review are resolved in the refrozen specification. One remaining bounded-input ambiguity requires an explicit maxLength for every free-text field before the contract design is approvable.
